Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch the main checkout, never run `uv`, never call a billed model, MCP indexing or the network, and never run `python -m bench run`, `python -m bench.frozen_prompts replay` or any script that calls a model. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv ; run tests as `PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider <tests>` (PYTHONPATH must include $PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src). Ruff: `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` and `-m ruff format <files>`. Leave changes uncommitted.

BACKGROUND. A character may be offered a knowledge entry as something it may "say aloud" (the 'sayable' list) when KnowledgeProjector._established (storygame/runtime/knowledge.py) finds every fact in the entry's `establishes` true. Alternate realizations of one storylet share the same `establishes` facts, so after one realization is narrated its unnarrated siblings also count as established and get offered as speech about events that never happened. There is no cumulative record of which entries were narrated: TurnDelivery.revealed_knowledge_ids (storygame/runtime/state.py) holds only the latest turn. Facts are the sole mutable truth, so the record must be a fact.

RULE TO IMPLEMENT. A character may only be offered, as speech, a storylet-realization knowledge entry (item.source.kind == "storylet_realization") that has actually been narrated. Entries of other source kinds (canonical_route_event, scene_entry) are NOT gated and behave exactly as today. Committed/grounding knowledge (the 'committed_knowledge' list and every use of _established outside the speaker list) is NOT changed: only the sayable list built by KnowledgeProjector._established_for is gated.

DESIGN (follow it exactly).
1. Record. In RuntimeState.apply_proposal (storygame/runtime/state.py), on the candidate fact store, assert one fact per id in proposal.selected_knowledge_ids: Fact(predicate="knowledge_narrated", subject=<knowledge id>, value="true"). Do this on the candidate store BEFORE `self.facts = candidate_facts`, so it commits atomically with the rest, is dropped when a game break stops the commit, and is rolled back by snapshot/restore and saved/loaded like every other fact. A repeated id must not create a duplicate fact. When selected_knowledge_ids is empty nothing is asserted.
2. Gate. In storygame/runtime/knowledge.py add a small module-level (or staticmethod) helper `is_narrated(item, facts) -> bool` that reads the facts (state.facts.matching("knowledge_narrated", item.id), value "true"). In KnowledgeProjector._established_for add the condition `(item.source.kind != "storylet_realization" or is_narrated(item, state.facts))` alongside the existing filters. Nothing else in knowledge.py changes. This is story-layer knowledge, not world-model logic, so it does NOT go in packages/worldkeeper.
3. Known limit to document in a code comment at the assert site, not to fix: the engine's forced-handoff fallback path (Engine._prepare_handoff with fallback_text) selects no knowledge id, so it does not mark an entry narrated.

TESTS FIRST. Before touching any non-test file, write tests/test_knowledge_narrated_gate.py and run it to see it fail for the right reason (record the failing output summary in your final notes). Required tests, using the real continuity-initiative package and the existing fixtures/patterns of tests/test_speaker_lines.py and tests/test_knowledge_projection.py (read them first; build states the same way they do, no network, no model):
 a) a storylet-realization entry whose establishes facts are true but which was never narrated is NOT in sayable_knowledge for its character audience; after apply_proposal with that id in selected_knowledge_ids it IS.
 b) siblings: with two realizations sharing the same establishes facts (use the real 3A pair k_sl_3a_a_r1 / k_sl_3a_a_r2 if both exist in the package; otherwise find a real sibling pair with a short search), narrating r1 makes r1 sayable and leaves r2 NOT sayable.
 c) a canonical_route_event or scene_entry entry that is established and voiceable stays exactly as sayable as before (no gate).
 d) committed_knowledge still includes an established but never-narrated realization (grounding unchanged).
 e) the fact `knowledge_narrated` for the id exists after apply_proposal, appears once after a second proposal with the same id, and is absent after state.restore_snapshot of an earlier snapshot.
 f) a proposal stopped by a game break does not assert the fact.
 g) the fact survives the repo's existing save/load round trip (find how tests exercise saving and loading a RuntimeState or session, copy that pattern) and the gate still holds after reload.
Then implement the minimum code and make the new tests pass.

EXISTING TESTS. Some existing tests assume that an established realization is sayable without having been narrated. Run these and, for each that now fails because of the new gate, update it to narrate the entry first (set selected_knowledge_ids through apply_proposal, or assert the knowledge_narrated fact the same way production does) so it keeps its original intent; never delete a test, never weaken an assertion, never loosen the gate to make a test pass. Tests: tests/test_richer_1c_voice.py tests/test_concealment_repro.py tests/test_knowledge_projection.py tests/test_defect_probe.py tests/test_voiceable_knowledge.py tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py tests/test_underside_exhausted.py tests/test_richer_1b_value.py tests/test_bench.py tests/test_open_probe.py tests/test_speaker_lines.py tests/test_cloudflare_transport.py. You may edit only those files, the new test file, storygame/runtime/knowledge.py and storygame/runtime/state.py. In your final notes list every existing test you changed and why.

OUTPUT. Leave the changes uncommitted in the worktree. The check exports the patch.
